Returns a list of all enum types registered in the system.

Use this endpoint to discover which enum types are available
for the GET /api/v1/enums/{enumName} endpoint.

**Response Format:**
```json
{
  "isSuccess": true,
  "statusCode": 200,
  "data": {
    "supportedEnums": [
      "AttachmentType",
      "AttachmentCategory",
      "EntityType"
    ],
    "count": 3,
    "baseUrl": "/api/v1/enums/{enumName}"
  }
}
```

Retrieve enum values with bilingual localization (English/Arabic).
Works for ANY enum across ALL modules (Identity, Attachment, Subscriptions, etc.).

**Supported Enum Types** (case-insensitive, accepts kebab-case, snake_case, PascalCase):
- Attachment Enums: `attachment-type`, `attachment-category`, `entity-type`
- More enums from other modules...

**Usage Examples:**
- `/api/v1/enums/attachment-category`
- `/api/v1/enums/AttachmentCategory`
- `/api/v1/enums/ATTACHMENTCATEGORY`
- `/api/v1/enums/attachment-type`

**Response Format:**
```json
{
  "isSuccess": true,
  "statusCode": 200,
  "data": {
    "enumName": "AttachmentType",
    "count": 4,
    "items": [
      {
        "id": 0,
        "key": "Image",
        "nameEn": "Image",
        "nameAr": "صورة"
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

**Cache:** Results are cached for 24 hours for optimal performance.

get.description: GET variant of phone validation. Query params: phoneNumber, countryCode.

post.description:
Validates a phone number and returns structured information.

**IsValid=false** is a valid 200 response — it means the number is invalid for the given country.
**422** is returned only when the request itself is malformed (empty phone or country code).

**CountryCode** examples: `EG`, `SA`, `AE`, `US`, `GB`
Use `ZZ` to validate any international number (requires leading '+').

**Example request:**
```json
{ "phoneNumber": "01012345678", "countryCode": "EG" }
```

**Example response (valid):**
```json
{
  "isValid": true,
  "e164": "+201012345678",
  "international": "+20 10 1234 5678",
  "national": "010 1234 5678",
  "kind": "Mobile",
  "countryCode": "EG"
}
```

put.description: A null clientSecret keeps the stored one. Send version to avoid lost updates (409).

post.description: Needs a complete configuration and at least one verified domain.
Sign-in through it stops immediately; enforcement is lifted (users fall back to other methods).
Returns the DNS TXT record to publish (recordName / recordValue).
409 sso_domain_unverified while the record is missing; 409 sso_domain_taken when another connection already verified it.

Re-reads the connection's IdP metadata URL (certificates and SSO URL). The metadata's entity id must equal the configured one. The outcome (Updated / Unchanged / Failed + error code) is in the result; the same refresh also runs on a schedule.
Returns the IdP URL to open. The IdP round trip signs nobody in; it returns to returnUrl with sso_test={code}. Works for draft connections.

get.description: The subject, email and every claim/attribute the IdP sent. Readable once.
get.summary: Result of an SSO connection test

post.description: Self-service sign-up: creates a company owned by the caller (shared isolation). Platform admins (tenants.manage) may choose dedicated isolation and the owner.

get.description: Profile of the current tenant. Members only.

put.description: Name, legal name, locale, currency, branding.

post.description: Owner only. The tenant becomes unavailable now and is purged after the grace period.
Returns the DNS TXT record to create; then call verify.
Owner only. Zip: control-plane data as JSON + every tenant table as CSV. Audited.
Owner only.

get.description: Newest first. Filters: endpointId, status, eventType.
Includes the exact payload and the truncated last response.

post.description: Queues a new delivery of the same event (same `webhook-id`) to the same endpoint.
Returns the signing secret ONCE (`whsec_...`). Deliveries follow the Standard Webhooks signature scheme.

delete.description: Deletes the endpoint and its delivery history.

put.description: `enabled: true` re-enables an auto-disabled endpoint and resets its failure counter.

post.description: Queues a signed `webhook.ping` delivery; follow it in the delivery log.
Issues a new secret (returned ONCE); the old one stops working immediately.

get.description: The public events an endpoint can subscribe to (use `*` for all).
